description: Figure 3b illustrates the BLEU scores for GPT-NEO 1.3B trained on the entire target dataset Dt. The x-axis is labeled “Epoch” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 3.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU score” and has a linear scale ranging from 1.0 to 4.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. Three lines are plotted: a solid blue line representing regular members, a dashed orange line representing members with near-duplicates, and a dash-dot green line representing held-out data. The solid blue line begins at approximately 2.1 at Epoch 0.0 and increases to approximately 3.8 at Epoch 3.0. The dashed orange line begins at approximately 2.0 at Epoch 0.0 and increases to approximately 3.5 at Epoch 3.0. The dash-dot green line begins at approximately 1.2 at Epoch 0.0 and increases to approximately 2.3 at Epoch 3.0.
